description: This file defines the main React component for managing notes in a frontend application. It manages state for notes, filtered notes, and selected note, and implements effects for fetching notes, handling search, tag selection, and favorites. It also provides handlers for creating, updating, and deleting notes, and renders the notes list and note editor.

methods.name: searchHandler
methods.description: Handles search event to filter notes based on search query.

methods.name: tagHandler
methods.description: Handles tag selection event to filter notes by tag.

methods.name: favoritesHandler
methods.description: Handles favorites selection event to fetch and display favorite notes.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving of a note, either by creating or updating it, then refetching notes.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note and updates the notes list.
